title: Technical/Onboarding Go High Level VA
description:
# Technical Virtual Assistant (GoHighLevel & Zapier) 



BlueSky Reputation is hiring a Technical Virtual Assistant to help onboard clients, manage systems, and support our growing reputation management agency.



We help local service businesses improve their online reputation, generate more Google reviews, and improve their Google Business Profile rankings.



This is a client-facing role. You will be speaking directly with U.S. business owners on Zoom and helping them get set up successfully.



This position starts part-time with the opportunity to grow into a larger role as the company expands.



**Pay:** $8-$10 per hour depending on experience



## REQUIREMENTS



* Exceptional spoken and written English

* Near-native level English required

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. business owners on Zoom

* GoHighLevel experience

* Zapier experience

* Strong technical troubleshooting skills

* Ability to research and solve technical problems independently

* Experience integrating software and CRMs

* Strong initiative and ownership mentality

* Reliable internet and computer

* Fast communication during business hours

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision

* Professional and friendly communication style



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Conduct client onboarding calls

* Set up GoHighLevel subaccounts

* Import snapshots

* Configure pipelines and automations

* Connect CRM systems

* Troubleshoot CRM integrations

* Connect Google Business Profiles

* Connect social media accounts

* Configure review campaigns

* Complete A2P verification for subaccount phone numbers

* Import customer lists and CSV files

* Merchynt onboarding and setup

* Basic website setup in GoHighLevel

* Customer support

* Lead list preparation and formatting

* SOP creation and documentation

* Trello management

* Technical troubleshooting

* Research and resolve client setup issues



## SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This position is paid for 10-15 hours per week to start.



The workload will vary. Some weeks may have several onboarding calls and projects, while other weeks may have very little active work.



Because this is a client-facing role, we are looking for someone who can provide reliable availability, fast communication, and flexibility to meet with clients when onboarding calls are scheduled.



You will not be expected to work a fixed daily schedule. Most work can be completed at flexible times.



However, you must:



* Respond quickly to messages during agreed-upon business hours

* Be available for scheduled client onboarding calls

* Provide timely customer support responses

* Communicate proactively regarding your availability



This role is ideal for someone who already has flexible remote work and can accommodate scheduled client meetings while maintaining excellent communication.



## INITIAL TRAINING



During the first several weeks, part of your paid hours will include:



* Learning our onboarding process

* Reviewing training materials

* Learning our systems and workflows

* Creating SOPs as processes are documented

* Building and organizing Trello boards

* Testing onboarding procedures

* Becoming familiar with our services and client setup process



All training, SOP creation, and onboarding preparation work is paid.



## COACHING & ONGOING TRAINING



The successful applicant will be added to our coaching and support group.



This includes:



* Access to ongoing training

* Ability to ask questions and get help with technical issues

* Access to group coaching calls

* Continued learning and skill development



Attendance at coaching calls is required as part of the role.



Coaching calls are held twice per week and are considered paid work time.



## IMPORTANT



Strong English is critical for this role.



Our clients are U.S. business owners, and you will be communicating with them directly. Applicants must be able to communicate naturally, confidently, and professionally in English.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership, solves problems independently, and enjoys figuring things out. Every client has a different setup, and successful applicants will be comfortable researching solutions and troubleshooting issues without needing step-by-step instructions for every task.



## TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A 2-3 minute video introduction

3. Your GoHighLevel experience

4. Your Zapier experience

5. Examples of technical problems you have solved independently

6. Your experience integrating CRMs or software platforms

7. Your weekly availability

8. Why you believe you would be a good fit for this role



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with the company.

title: HR Onboarding Specialist (Healthcare)
description:
We’re looking for an HR Onboarding Specialist to support a fast-growing health-tech platform serving home health and care organizations. This role is responsible for owning the end-to-end onboarding and credentialing process for both clinical and administrative hires, with a strong focus on compliance, documentation accuracy, and operational follow-through.



This is a detail-heavy, process-driven role ideal for someone with prior healthcare HR experience who understands confidentiality, regulatory requirements, and the real consequences of onboarding delays or compliance gaps.



If you are organized, methodical, and comfortable owning sensitive workflows in a regulated environment, this role is a strong fit.



Why You’ll Want to Join

- You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

- Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

- 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you’re most productive

- Work inside a health-tech company solving real operational pain points

- High ownership role supporting hiring, compliance, and growth



What You’ll Work On:

New Hire Onboarding:

- Coordinate all onboarding activities for clinical and administrative hires

- Guide new hires through onboarding portals and ensure timely submission of required documents

- Prepare and distribute offer letters, employment agreements, and onboarding packets

- Coordinate background checks, drug screenings, and account setup



Credentialing and Compliance

- Collect and verify clinical licenses and certifications such as RN, LVN, PT, OT, CPR, immunizations, TB tests, and related records

- Track and monitor credential expirations using HRIS or compliance systems

- Send renewal reminders proactively and follow through until completion

- Ensure compliance with state regulations, Medicare and Medicaid requirements, and accreditation standards



Background Checks and Screening:

- Initiate and manage background checks, OIG exclusions, and reference verifications through approved vendors

- Review screening results and escalate any red flags to HR leadership

- Maintain accurate records in compliance with FCRA, EEOC, and internal policies



Documentation and Recordkeeping

- Ensure all onboarding forms, credentialing documents, and training records are complete before orientation

- Maintain personnel files with accuracy, confidentiality, and HIPAA compliance

- Audit files regularly for completeness and accuracy

- Coordinate with clinical leaders to ensure credentialing is complete before patient care begins



Process Improvement and Reporting

- Identify opportunities to improve onboarding and credentialing workflows

- Generate reports on onboarding status, credential compliance, and expiring documents

- Support internal and external audits by preparing and submitting required documentation



What You Bring:

- 2+ years of experience in HR onboarding, credentialing, or compliance

- Prior experience in healthcare or home health environments strongly preferred

- Strong understanding of confidentiality, compliance, and documentation standards

- High attention to detail with strong organizational skills

- Experience working with HRIS systems and background check platforms

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools

- Clear written and verbal English communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple onboarding workflows at once without errors



Nice to Have:

- Experience supporting clinical credentialing workflows

- Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, or accreditation standards

- Prior experience supporting audits or regulatory reviews

- Experience working in remote or offshore HR teams

If you thrive in structured environments, understand the importance of compliant onboarding in healthcare, and enjoy owning operational processes end to end, this role offers stability, ownership, and long-term growth in a scaling health-tech company.

mber.

title: Full-Stack Developer — Luxury Childcare Platform (Supabase, Stripe, Integrations)
description:
Full-Stack Developer — Luxury Childcare Platform (Supabase, Stripe, Integrations)



Job type: Full-time for the build phase, then a part-time retainer for maintenance and scaling

Hours: Full-time during the build, with a few hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time

Compensation: Competitive, monthly in USD, by experience (range at the bottom)

Start date: Immediately





About us



We are House of Nannies, a luxury domestic-staffing agency serving New York, Connecticut, New Jersey, and the Hamptons. We are launching Little Minders, an on-demand sitter membership, and we run our operations on our own internal platform, The Nest.



The Nest is already fully designed, end to end — every screen, flow, and rule has been worked out and documented. We have a complete set of reference designs (heirloom-styled HTML), a written rulebook for how profiles and matching work, role-versioned contracts, settings/taxonomy, and clear build tasks. We know exactly what we want. We need a strong developer to implement it faithfully, ship it, and then maintain and scale it.



This is a real product, with real families and real money moving through it. We care about reliability, a calm and beautiful user experience, and doing things properly.



The stack





Front end: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (single-file pages today; you may propose a sensible framework if it speeds delivery without bloating)

Back end: Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Row-Level Security, Edge Functions)

Hosting: Netlify

Payments: Stripe (membership billing in use; Stripe Connect + invoicing to build)

Already integrated: Google Calendar two-way sync; an AI résumé-parsing edge function

AI: we use AI for résumé parsing and profile generation (the rules are documented)





You inherit a working codebase and a complete design package — reference HTML for every screen, a build-task list, an AI profile rulebook, contract templates, and written business rules. You're building from clear specs, not a blank page.



What you'll build (from our designs and specs)



Communications & notifications





An in-app messaging inbox (candidate ? team, family ? team) — currently our biggest gap

Browser/desktop notifications + sound (Web Notifications API + service worker for closed-app push)

A persistent badge that reflects a count of outstanding items and clears only when everything's handled (not on a single click)





Profiles & matching (from the rulebook)





Role-matched profiles: a candidate can hold multiple roles (nanny, newborn care specialist, housekeeper, personal assistant, family assistant); the family sees the profile matched to the role applied for

Redaction at the data/RPC layer: references, last name (until offer), "why a role ended" (internal), and graduation year are hidden in the data, not just the UI

A multi-role application input where a candidate fills capabilities per role, feeding the matched profile

A configurable Settings · Lists taxonomy (tags, types, statuses + sub-statuses, availability, at-a-glance fields). It must import and preserve our existing data — never wipe it.





Contracts & e-signature





Generate the agreement from the role + the family's children/intake + the accepted offer (duties are produced per placement)

In-platform e-signature (we do NOT use SignWell) that captures an audit trail: signer, IP address, date/timestamp, device as the signature certificate

Contract states: internal draft / client draft (legal-review flags visible to the family, never to the candidate) / clean signed version (flags disappear); archive a timestamped disclaimer copy for the record

A separate independent-contractor agreement type for newborn care specialists





Payments — Stripe





Embedded card capture (Stripe Elements) — families pay inside the platform, card on file, no redirect

Stripe Connect: sitter onboarding so sitters receive payouts; auto-route cancellation/rush fees, bonuses, and reimbursements to the right sitter

Membership billing (tiers, overage, low-credit handling)

Placement fees invoiced via Stripe Invoicing, collected by ACH bank debit (not card) to avoid high fees on large amounts

A deposit step at client activation





Little Minders booking





Booking-request flow (notify matching sitters, favorites first ? interest ? family confirms ? contact released only after confirmation)

Tokenized no-login links with redaction enforced at the database layer (RLS / security-definer functions)

Rush/short-notice priority queue; reliability scoring per sitter

Sitter onboarding: background check (we add the sitter's
 in the provider portal), CPR upload, references, evaluations





Workflow & internal tools





A merged Tasks & Routines tab: personal daily routines + tasks (private per user) and a shared team to-do list (claim ? "working on it" with assignee ? "completed by")

Calendar wired to family + candidate portals (per-member read-only OAuth)

Job board status synced to search stage with manual override

A Resources tab (internal vs. client), with internal resources view-only/no-download, and resources auto-tagged to a client's profile based on their situation

Records page, recycle bin/soft-delete, stage history & audit logging (largely designed)





Integrations (bigger lifts)





: a transactional + marketing service (Resend / Postmark / SendGrid) — redesigned stage-based templates and segmented blasts

Video in-platform for interviews; AI transcripts attached to the right candidate record

(Done already: a VideoAsk link for the Fast Track intro step)





Mobile apps — App Store & Google Play





Publish the platform to both stores (e.g., wrapping the web app with Capacitor), with push notifications

Configure payments to pass store review (our memberships pay for a real-world service, generally exempt from Apple IAP — Stripe must stay within guidelines)





Quality & scale





Fast, smooth, simple. Clean schema, proper indexing, no hard cap on users. Documented, maintainable code.





Required experience





Strong JavaScript and front-end development

Supabase or Postgres — Auth, Row-Level Security, SQL, Edge/serverless functions

Stripe — especially Stripe Connect (payouts, transfers, webhooks), plus Elements, Invoicing, and ACH debit. Essential.

REST APIs and webhooks; comfortable integrating third-party services end to end

Good written English and a few hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time





Nice to have





Two-sided marketplace / platform experience

Publishing to the App Store and Google Play (Capacitor, React Native, or PWA-to-app)

-service, video SDK (Zoom / Daily / Whereby), and AI / speech-to-text (Whisper / Deepgram / AssemblyAI) integration

Netlify, Google Calendar API, or AI/LLM experience





How we work





Milestone-based delivery with clear scope and check-ins. Build additively — we have an existing platform and live data; never wipe it.

Site Health Score (target: 95%+)

2+ years of hands-on SEO execution — actual on-page work, not agency reporting

SEMrush — site audit, position tracking, keyword research, competitor gap analysis

WordPress — confident editing pages and content without breaking things

Yoast SEO — meta titles, descriptions, content scoring

Content writing/editing — ability to rewrite copy for a B2B science audience

title: Brand Marketing Coordinator
description:
# Brand Marketing Coordinator

**Karst — North Charleston, SC**



Karst is a strategic merch and creative agency. We help lifestyle and growth-stage brands extend who they are into the physical world — intentionally, at scale, never the disposable junk that ends up in a drawer. We've been doing it since 1996.



Here's the honest version of why this role exists:



Our founder has the marketing strategy. The ideas, the calendar, the direction — all there. What's missing is the person who takes it and *makes it real*. Designs it, builds it, posts it, ships it.



That's you.



This isn't a brief-and-wait role. You'll own marketing execution end to end, so the strategy actually leaves the building instead of dying in a doc.



## What you'll own

- **Internal marketing.** You turn strategy and rough ideas into finished, on-brand work.

- **Social content.** We hand you a bucket of ideas and raw material — you finesse it, design it, schedule it, and actually hit publish.

- **HubSpot.**
, landing pages, workflows, keeping the CRM working for us instead of the other way around.

- **WordPress.** Updates, campaign hubs, landing pages, keeping the site sharp.

- **Quality control** on any overflow design we send to contractors — so the founder doesn't have to babysit it.



## Who you are

- You've spent **at least 3 years doing marketing execution** — not studying it, not "assisting with" it. Designing, building, posting, owning it.

- You can design *and* organize. Rare combo. That's the whole point of this seat.

- **HubSpot:** you've built
s, workflows, and landing pages in it — not just hit "send" on a campaign someone else set up.

- **WordPress:** you've built and edited pages, not only written blog posts.

- You're sharp in Canva and ideally Adobe, and you have a portfolio that proves it.

- You'd rather own a thing than wait for instructions. You won't get daily art direction here.

- You have taste, you sweat the details, and you'll tell us when something's off-brand or not good enough yet.



Honestly? I care less about the exact year count than what you can show me. But green won't cut it for this seat — you'll be running things, not learning them on our dime.



## This isn't your seat if

- You need a detailed brief and a sign-off before every task.

title: Instagram Story Designer (Story Sequences)
description:
I run a marketing agency and I need someone reliable to build Instagram story sequences for me and my clients. These are multi slide story posts with bold text overlays, highlights, arrows, and embedded photos laid over a background image. If you have a good eye for clean layouts and can follow a template closely, this is for you.



There are two parts to the job:



Part 1: One off batch (start here)

I will give you one finished story sequence as the master template. Your job is to rebuild that exact same sequence for 15 different people. Same copy, same layout, same style on every slide. The only thing that changes is the background photo for each person. So 15 versions of the same sequence, just swapped backgrounds.



Part 2: Ongoing (the main role)

Once you nail the batch, you move into an ongoing role building fresh story sequences for me personally, every day or every other day. I will give you the copy and direction, you build the slides in the same style and send them back ready to post.



What you will do



 • Rebuild story sequences slide by slide from a template

 • Swap background images cleanly without breaking the layout

 • Keep text, spacing, highlights, and arrows consistent across every slide

 • Export in correct story dimensions ready to upload

 • Turn work around quickly and follow feedback the first time



What I am looking for



 • Strong design eye, clean and consistent work

 • Comfortable with Canva, Photoshop, or similar (tell me what you use)

 • Fast, organised, and good at following a template exactly

 • Reliable daily availability and quick replies

 • Bonus if you have made Instagram story or reel content before



Hours

Part time. The one off batch of 15 sequences is the paid trial. If it goes well this becomes an ongoing role building one sequence a day or every other day.



Pay

$150 to $200/month depending on experience, for ongoing daily or every other day work. The first 15 sequence batch is the trial and is paid.



To apply



 1. Send 2 or 3 examples of story or social content you have made

 2. Tell me what tools you use

 4. Confirm you’re happy with the pay range and tell me your availability



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Go High Level Website Designer
description:
GOHLEVEL WEBSITE DESIGNER NEEDED - IT COMPANY - SPOKANE, WA



We are building a professional multi-page website inside GoHighLevel for a managed IT and technology advisory company. This is a website, not a funnel. If your portfolio is funnel pages and automation screenshots this job is not for you.





THE PROJECT



44 pages total broken into two phases.



PHASE ONE is 8 pages and the priority: home, about, contact, book a free assessment, 404, privacy policy, terms and conditions, and cookie policy. Get these live fast.



PHASE TWO is the remaining 36 pages: a services overview, 15 individual service pages, an advisory services overview, 5 advisory service pages, an industries overview, 8 industry pages, a client agreements page, 4 agreement pages, and a sitemap. These complete the project and are due by end of July.



PHASE THREE of 160 additional pages may follow as a separate project if the site converts. That is not part of this contract.





WHAT IS READY FOR YOU



We have done our homework. Every page has a suggested copy draft, section-by-section layout direction, brand color palette, voice and context documents, site architecture, and SEO requirements all prepared and waiting for you.



The copy is a strong starting point, not a paste-and-publish draft. We need someone with strong English writing skills and real conversion copywriting ability to review, refine, and rewrite where needed so every section speaks directly to our target audience and drives them to take action. If you can design and write, you are exactly who we are looking for. If design is your strength and writing is not, this is not the right fit. 



You are not starting from scratch. You are taking a thoroughly planned site and making it both beautiful and sharp enough to convert. 





WHAT WE ARE BUILDING



Modern, and clean. Warm and personal, not cold corporate. Think SaaS company aesthetic with a human side. Conversion focused above everything else. Beautiful design matters. When design and conversion conflict, conversion wins. 



The site must be built natively in GHL with full edit controls on every element. Code is welcome for enhancing specific visual details and animations but the foundation must be native GHL, not a code block drop-in. We want to be able to edit content after you leave without touching code. 



Fully mobile responsive. Tested before delivery. Not optional.





COMPENSATION AND TIMELINE



$5 per hour, $300 project maximum. We estimate 40 hours for a designer who knows GHL well and can write. Phase one live as fast as you can professionally deliver it. Full project complete by end of July.





WHO THIS IS FOR



You have built real multi-page GHL websites with navigation, service pages, and clear design intent behind them. You write well in English and understand how copy, layout, and visual hierarchy work together to move someone from curious to converted. You know the difference between copy that sounds good and copy that actually gets people to act. You work well from a detailed brief without heavy hand-holding. 





HOW TO APPLY

Share two or more links to full GHL websites you have built. Not funnels. Websites. If the sites you share also reflect strong copy decisions, even better. 



Tell us in one paragraph why you are the right fit. Candidates will be carefully selected.

s; follow up on open threads

, TikTok, Instagram Reels, or similar platforms

/TikTok ad videos

title: Paid Advertising Manager (Meta & Google)
description:
We run paid acquisition for a growing roster of UK and international clients across e-commerce, hospitality and B2B. We need someone who can own paid media end to end — build it, run it, prove it works — without us having to check the tracking afterwards.



This is hands-on. You'll be in the ad accounts daily-ish, not writing strategy decks for someone else to execute. If you like building campaigns and watching numbers move, this is for you. If you want to manage other people who do the actual work, it isn't.



## What you'll do



- Build, launch and optimise **Meta** 
/Instagram) campaigns across the full funnel

- Build, launch and optimise **Google Ads** — Search, **Performance Max** and **Shopping**

- Set up and maintain **Google Merchant Center** feeds (product data, disapprovals, feed quality)

- Own tracking integrity: **Google Tag Manager** containers, triggers, variables, dataLayer, conversion tags

- Configure and audit **GA4** — key events, conversions, attribution, exploration reports, debugging

- Implement and verify **Meta Pixel + Conversions API** (server-side where needed)

- Manage budgets and pacing across multiple accounts simultaneously

- Produce clear performance reporting clients can actually understand (Looker Studio or similar)

- Diagnose and fix broken or duplicate tracking setups before they corrupt bidding signals



## What you need to have



Non-negotiable:



- Demonstrable hands-on experience managing **both Meta and Google Ads** (not one or the other)

- Real **Performance Max and Shopping** experience — not just Search campaigns

- Genuine working knowledge of **GTM**: you can build a container from scratch and debug one that's misfiring

- **GA4** competence: setup, event/conversion configuration, and the ability to spot when data is wrong

- **Google Merchant Center** / product feed management

- Comfortable owning multiple client accounts in an agency context

- Self-managing — you hit deadlines without being chased



Nice to have:



- Server-side GTM

- Shopify e-commerce experience

- Meta CAPI / server-side conversions

- Feed management tools (e.g. DataFeedWatch, Channable)

- Google Ads and/or GA4 certifications



## How we hire



Shortlisted candidates will be given a short, practical assessment — a real tracking or campaign scenario to diagnose. CV claims don't get you the role; demonstrating you can actually do the work does.



## Logistics



- Part-time hours, flexible — agreed up front

- Fully remote

- Day rate or hourly, depending on how you work — tell us your rates

- UK-based or UK-hours overlap



## To apply



Send a short note telling us:

1. The single best paid media result you've delivered, and how you proved it was you

2. One time you found broken tracking and what you did about it

3. Your availability and rates



No covering-letter waffle. We read the first two answers first.

mber has missed a deadline

title: Hospice Coding Specialist (Remote – Philippines)
description:
About EZ Scribe LLC



EZ Scribe LLC provides clinical documentation, coding, and compliance support exclusively to U.S.-based hospice organizations. Our mission is to help hospice providers maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation while meeting Medicare, CMS, and regulatory requirements.



We are expanding our hospice coding division and are seeking an experienced Hospice Coding Specialist who can independently review, code, and support hospice documentation across multiple client organizations and electronic medical record (EMR) systems.



This position is designed for highly skilled professionals who require minimal supervision and can confidently manage coding responsibilities while maintaining compliance with Medicare hospice regulations.



Position Overview:



We are hiring a seasoned Hospice Coding Specialist to work remotely from the Philippines. The primary responsibility is reviewing hospice documentation and assigning accurate ICD-10 codes that support hospice eligibility, reimbursement, and regulatory compliance.



The ideal candidate has extensive experience working with U.S. Medicare-certified hospice providers, understands hospice clinical documentation requirements, and can adapt quickly to multiple EMR platforms and organizational workflows.



Only applicants with proven hospice coding experience supporting U.S. hospice providers will be considered.



Key Responsibilities:



Hospice ICD-10 Coding

-Review hospice admission, recertification, transfer, revocation, discharge, and death records.

-Assign accurate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes supporting terminal prognosis and related conditions.

-Ensure coding accurately reflects the patient's terminal illness, comorbidities, and symptom burden.

-Maintain compliance with Medicare hospice regulations, CMS guidelines, and coding standards.



Hospice Eligibility & Documentation Review:



-Review physician certifications, face-to-face encounter documentation, hospice election statements, and supporting clinical records.

-Verify documentation supports hospice eligibility and terminal prognosis requirements.

-Identify missing, conflicting, or insufficient documentation that could increase audit or denial risk.

-Provide clear and concise feedback to clinicians and hospice staff regarding documentation deficiencies.



Compliance & Regulatory Support:



-Stay current on Medicare hospice regulations, CMS guidance, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and hospice Conditions of Participation.

-Assist hospice providers in maintaining documentation that is audit-ready and compliant.

-Support preparation for ADRs, TPE reviews, UPIC audits, and other regulatory reviews when needed.



Quality Assurance Support:



-Perform chart audits and documentation reviews as needed.

-Review nursing, social work, chaplain, hospice aide, volunteer, and interdisciplinary documentation for completeness and compliance.

-Ensure plans of care, interdisciplinary group (IDG) documentation, visit notes, and recertification records support the patient's hospice status and ongoing eligibility.

-Identify trends and opportunities for documentation improvement.



Multi-Organization Support:



-Work independently across multiple hospice organizations simultaneously.

-Adapt to different documentation standards, workflows, and operational requirements.

-Maintain productivity while managing varying client expectations and deadlines.

-Demonstrate the ability to work autonomously with minimal oversight.



EMR & System Proficiency:



-Navigate and work efficiently within multiple hospice EMR systems.

-Learn new charting platforms quickly with minimal training.

-Maintain organization and accuracy while switching between client environments.



Collaboration:



-Communicate effectively with hospice clinicians, administrators, quality assurance personnel, compliance teams, and physicians.

-Participate in case discussions and coding reviews as needed.

-Provide education and coding guidance when documentation clarification is required.



Qualifications:



-Required Experience

-Minimum 3 years of direct hospice coding experience supporting U.S. Medicare-certified hospice providers.

-Demonstrated experience independently coding hospice charts and reviewing documentation for compliance.

-Experience supporting multiple hospice organizations and managing competing priorities.

-Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Certifications:



One or more of the following certifications is required or strongly preferred:

-HCS-H

-HCS-D

-CPC

-CCS

-BCHH-C

Other recognized hospice or coding certifications



Hospice Expertise:



-Advanced understanding of Medicare hospice regulations and Conditions of Participation.

-Strong knowledge of hospice eligibility requirements, terminal diagnosis selection, and supporting documentation requirements.

-Ability to identify documentation deficiencies that may affect reimbursement, compliance, or audit outcomes.

-Familiarity with LCD guidelines, hospice audit risk areas, and documentation standards.

-Strong understanding of physician certifications, face-to-face requirements, recertifications, and hospice election documentation.



Clinical Background:



-Registered Nurse (RN)

-Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)

-Hospice clinician with coding experience

-Graduate of an accredited medical coding program with significant hospice experience



Technical Skills:



-Experience working within multiple hospice EMR systems.

-Familiarity with platforms such as MatrixCare, Netsmart, WellSky Hospice, Axxess Hospice, Suncoast, HospiceWorks, or similar hospice-specific systems.

-Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and secure cloud-based file sharing.



Communication:



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to write clear coding rationale, documentation feedback, audit findings, and compliance notes.



Work Environment:



-Fully remote position.

-Reliable high-speed internet connection required.

-Secure and HIPAA-compliant workspace required.

-Ability to work during U.S. business hours.



Compliance Requirements:



-Must sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA).

-Must comply with HIPAA privacy and security requirements.

-Must maintain strict confidentiality of all protected health information.



Compensation & Benefits:



-Competitive hourly compensation based on experience, certifications, and hospice expertise.

-Long-term remote opportunity.

-Flexible scheduling options.

-Exposure to multiple hospice organizations and clinical environments.

-Opportunity for advancement into senior coding, auditing, and compliance roles.



How to Apply,  Please submit:



-Resume/CV

-Proof of coding certification(s)

-Cover letter detailing your hospice coding experience



In your application, please include:



-The U.S. hospice organizations or hospice projects you have supported.

-Your years of hospice coding experience.

-Hospice EMR systems you have worked within.

-Examples of how you have independently managed coding responsibilities across multiple hospice organizations.

-Experience supporting hospice compliance, audits, documentation improvement, or quality assurance initiatives.



Applications from candidates without direct U.S. hospice coding experience will not be considered.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper / Real Estate Accounting Specialist
description:
**QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper / Real Estate Accounting Specialist (Remote)**



**About Us**



Stefan Capital Group is a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in vacant land acquisitions, subdivisions, owner-financed land sales, and real estate investments. We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced QuickBooks Online bookkeeper to help maintain accurate financial records and support our growing business.



**Position Overview**



We are looking for a highly organized bookkeeper with strong QuickBooks Online experience. Real estate accounting experience is preferred, especially involving land transactions, notes receivable, seller financing, and investor partnerships.



This position will begin part-time with the potential for ongoing long-term work.



**Responsibilities**



* Maintain and reconcile QuickBooks Online accounts

* Categorize and record transactions accurately

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and loans

* Track land inventory purchases and sales

* Manage Notes Receivable from owner-financed sales

* Record down payments, monthly payments, principal reductions, and interest income

* Prepare monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports

* Track investor contributions and profit-sharing arrangements

* Assist with year-end reporting and CPA requests

* Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation

title: Digital Marketing Executor (Local SEO Focus)
description:
Who We Are



We’re Fresh Tech Maids (
), a Chicago-based chemical-free cleaning company. For over 10 years we’ve delivered cleaner, healthier, safer homes for families, parents, and seniors — using technology (deionized water, steam, HEPA filtration) instead of toxic chemicals. Three locations. Hundreds of 5-star reviews. A founder with an MBA and a #1 Amazon book who has already built the marketing strategy and the playbook.



We’re aiming for strong, measured growth in 2026 and beyond. That’s where you come in.



Who We Need



(1) We need an experienced digital marketing professional. Not a trainee. Not someone starting from zero.

(2) Execution of our playbook is what we need.

(3) The strategy exists. The KPI dashboard exists. The playbook is documented. We need the person who executes it with discipline and proves it with numbers every week.

(4) We live by the optimize — measure — learn cycle. Every project has a number. Every number gets tracked. Every result shapes what we do next. If that’s how you already work, keep reading.



Are You This Person?



(1) Accountable. You own your numbers. You don’t blame tools, the market, or the algorithm.

(2) Deadline-driven. You hit dates. When something slips, you flag it early.

(3) Data-first. You check dashboards before you share opinions.

(4) Measurement-minded. You think in baselines, targets, and deltas.

(5) Curious. You ask “what’s working?” and “why?” every week.

(6) Honest. You say when something isn’t working. No sugarcoating, no spin.



What You’ll Do



You’ll execute the marketing system that brings qualified leads into our pipeline — calls, web chats,
s, and online bookings. Real projects, real numbers, real deadlines:



(1) Local SEO (the core) — manage 3 Google Business Profiles; monitor weekly Semrush Map Rank Tracker geo-grids; grow our local map-pack visibility.

(2) Relationship-based link earning — nurture relationships with Chicago bloggers, green-living creators, hyperlocal sites, and pet/realtor creators that earn quality links to our pillar blogs.

(3) Listicle & citation placements — “best of Chicago” directories and citation correction across our 3 locations.

(4) Content repurposing & social — turn our bi-weekly pillar blogs into GBP posts,
/Instagram posts, and short-video scripts (3+ per platform weekly; 90%+ with no external links).

(5) Backlink hygiene — maintain our Semrush backlink audit and weekly disavow workflow (SOP provided).

(6)
, Reddit & Quora — run value-first campaigns and community presence that support SEO and generate leads.

(7) Reporting — update the KPI dashboard weekly; flag what’s moving and what isn’t.



Schema markup, all website changes, review-request sending, and short-video production are handled by our webmaster and client-service team — you coordinate with them and write the video scripts; you don’t do those tasks yourself.



Every project has a goal. Every goal has a number. Every number gets reviewed.



Your Background



(1) 3+ years of real, hands-on digital marketing experience with meaningful local SEO work (coursework alone won’t cut it).

(2) Working proficiency in Semrush or Ahrefs — shortlisted candidates walk us through a real campaign they ran, live on a screen-share.

(3) Hands-on Google Business Profile management.

(4) A track record of setting goals, measuring results, and hitting targets.

(5) Strong writing — short, clear, persuasive English.

(6) Comfort with GA4,
 platforms, and SEO software.

(7) A 4-year Bachelor’s degree.

(8) Honesty about what you know and what you still need to learn.



Nice to have: Webflow, schema/JSON-LD, basic graphic/video familiarity.



To show us you read this far: include the word “deionized” in the first line of your application.



How We Work (this is the deal)



(1) Daily async check-in (15 lines: what shipped yesterday, what ships today, blockers). We do not use surveillance or screen-monitoring software. We manage by visible output, not watched hours — your work must be visible: links earned, posts published, scans run, dashboard updated.

(2) Weekly 1-hour Zoom with the founder to review the KPI dashboard.

(3) Schedule: a full-time engagement (about 40 hours/week of focused work) with at least 3–4 hours overlapping US Central mornings as a communication window.

(4) Dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable internet plus a backup for internet and power. This is a stay-in-place role — not a work-while-traveling role; nomad setups don’t deliver the reliability this position needs.

(5) Exclusivity: this is a full-time commitment — you won’t take on other clients while engaged with us.

(6) Company tools provided under a company
 we set up for you (Semrush, AI writing tools, and the rest). You never use personal accounts for company work.



Growth Path & Pay



This role has a clear growth ladder. As your measured results grow, your pay grows.



Level 1 (Intermediate) — $8/hour-equivalent

Level 2 (Intermediate plus) — $9/hour-equivalent

Level 3 (Advanced Specialist) — $11/hour-equivalent

Level 4 (Master Marketer) — $13/hour-equivalent

Level 5 (Authority Expert) — $15/hour-equivalent



Because this role requires proven experience, qualified hires enter at Level 2–3 (a fixed monthly salary of roughly $1,280–$1,700) based on demonstrated skills. We pay a fixed monthly salary for the role and your availability window — not an hourly timesheet. From there we move people up based on measured results, not tenure. A modest quarterly bonus is tied to campaign outcomes (map visibility, lead volume); your base never depends on outcomes outside your control.



Benefits

(1) Company-paid AI tools built into everything we do

(2) Honest, ethical managers — real support including from the company President

(3) A documented training/onboarding program (you ramp in weeks, not months)

(4) A clear path to higher pay and more responsibility

13th-month pay

(5) 6 paid US National Holidays

(6) 5 paid personal days in Year 1; 10 from Year 2



Our Culture & Values



(1) Direct, honest, empathetic communication

(2) Always learning — optimize, measure, learn

(3) Data-driven, not ego-driven

(4) Team connection — no one left isolated

(5) Integrity, every time



How We Hire



This role matters to us, so we take hiring seriously:



(1) A short survey.

(2) A small work sample.

(3) A video interview with a live screen-share of a Semrush/Ahrefs campaign you personally ran.

(4) A Zoom interview with the founder.

(5) A paid 4-week trial at full salary, with real deliverables and clear, written acceptance criteria agreed before you start. We may run this trial with more than one candidate at the same time — if so, we’ll tell you openly, and everyone is paid in full. Pass the trial ? permanent, long-term role.



We’re looking for one person to grow with for years — not a contractor for a month. 



How to Apply



(1) A proposal starting with “deionized”

(2) 3 reasons why you are a good fit.

(3) Your availability in US Central hours and your weekly rate.



If you’ve read this far and you’re the disciplined, tool-proficient executor we’re describing, we want to hear from you.

title: Healthcare & Legal Cybersecurity / Compliance Engineer (HIPAA + Law Firms)
description:
Are you a cybersecurity pro who wants to work on cutting-edge AI systems — and be the person who makes sure they're locked down and fully compliant?



We're a U.S.-based technology company building local AI and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems for medical clinics and law firms. As we deploy AI systems that access sensitive patient records and confidential legal files, we need a sharp, self-driven Cybersecurity & Compliance Engineer to own security and compliance across our client environments. This is a high-trust, senior role where your work directly enables AI systems to operate safely and legally inside some of the most sensitive data environments that exist.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Assess and harden the IT environments of our medical clinic and law firm clients (endpoints, networks, file systems, cloud storage)

- Design and implement secure remote access (VPN, MFA, IAM, network segmentation) so our AI engineers can safely work with client data

- Ensure medical clinic clients are fully HIPAA-compliant — risk assessments, Security Rule safeguards, policies, i
 response, and BAAs with AI vendors

- Build practical security policies and SOPs for law firm clients around client confidentiality, secure file handling, and least-privilege access

- Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting so that access to sensitive data — especially by AI systems — is always traceable and auditable

- Work closely with our AI engineering team to make sure new deployments don't introduce compliance or security gaps



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE



- 3+ years in cybersecurity, IT security, or systems engineering

- Real-world experience with HIPAA or U.S. healthcare / healthcare BPO environments

- Experience securing environments where medical, legal, or financial data must be tightly controlled

- Strong hands-on skills: VPNs, firewalls, MFA, endpoint encryption, IAM, and logging/monitoring

- Ability to translate compliance frameworks into practical technical controls

- Great written English — you'll be writing policies and SOPs for doctors and lawyers, not just engineers

- Self-directed and comfortable working remotely with a U.S. tech team



BONUS POINTS FOR



- Experience with law firm environments or legal case-management systems

- Experience securing AI/ML systems or data pipelines that touch sensitive data

- Certifications such as Security+, CISSP, HCISPP, or formal HIPAA compliance training



WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH YOUR TIME



- 100% remote, long-term, stable position with a growing U.S. AI technology company

- You will be THE security and compliance person — high visibility, real ownership, real impact

- Direct collaboration with AI engineers and company leadership

- Genuinely interesting work — AI, medical records, legal tech, and compliance all intersecting in one role

- Salary: $2,500 to $3,200 USD per month depending on experience and certifications — paid in USD



HOW TO APPLY



Please include all three of the following or your application will not be reviewed:



1. Describe one HIPAA or healthcare security project you worked on — what was your role and what did you personally implement?



2. Describe one project where you secured sensitive data for a professional services environment (legal, medical, finance, etc.)



3. In 5 to 10 bullet points, outline how you would securely allow remote AI engineers to access patient files at a medical clinic while maintaining HIPAA compliance.

title: Shopify E-commerce Manager
description:
About us. On Peak Brands runs 
, one of the largest personalized-gift stores of its kind, built over 23+ years from a single mall kiosk to 1,500+ SKUs, 150+ collections, and 1,000,000+ customers. We are a small, systems-driven team based in Florida. We move fast and we expect the people who join us to own their lane.



The role. We are hiring one person to own and run our Shopify channel. Not to take tickets. To own the number. You will be accountable for the growth and profitability of the MyOrnament storefront: conversion, average order value, repeat purchase, catalog merchandising, on-site SEO, and the upcoming site rebuild. You will set the agenda, run the tests, direct our developers, and bring us results, not to-do lists.



What you will own:



The Shopify channel's performance: conversion rate, AOV, and the on-site experience.

A continuous, hypothesis-driven CRO test backlog.

Merchandising and on-site SEO across a large, seasonal catalog, including new occasion-based categories.

Project management of our Shopify rebuild, including briefing and supervising outside developers.

Listing and product-data quality to our brand and SEO standards.

Manage and collaborate with SEO agency. 

Manage and collaborate with paid media agency. 

Experience we require:



4 to 7 years in ecommerce, including at least 2 to 3 years owning a Shopify store's performance (not just executing tasks on one).

A track record of conversion-rate or AOV improvements you can describe with before-and-after numbers.

Fluency in GA4 and Shopify Analytics: you diagnose funnels, you do not just pull reports.

Experience merchandising a large catalog (hundreds to thousands of SKUs) with collections and metafields.

Experience running an ecommerce business through a concentrated peak season (Q4 or equivalent).

Experience project-managing a Shopify build, migration, or replatform and directing developers. You brief and supervise dev work; you are not expected to code production themes.

On-site and merchandising SEO: product and collection page optimization.

Strong written English and a track record of working autonomously with a remote, US-based team.



Nice to have:



Personalized gifts, gifting, or seasonal DTC experience.

OmniSend or comparable
-platform familiarity.

Experience inside an EOS-run company (L10, Rocks, scorecards).





How We Work

We are a founder-led business that runs lean.

We value ownership, initiative, and clear written communication. People here are trusted to take responsibility, solve problems independently, and bring ideas to the table.

We move quickly, support one another, and expect people to challenge the way things are done when they see a better path.



Most importantly we are obsessed with learning. We encourage personal and professional development.



Peak Season

Holiday Traditions does the majority of its volume during Q4.

Planning for and executing through peak season is a critical part of this role and an important contributor to overall business success.





You are right for this if you:



Have run a Shopify store as an operator, not just executed tasks on one.

Read analytics the way other people read a sentence, and can prove a change moved a number.

Have shipped CRO wins you can describe with before-and-after data.

Can direct developers without needing to be one.

Work autonomously across a US-Eastern-overlapping schedule and communicate in clear written English.



You are wrong for this if you want a defined task list handed to you each morning, or need sign-off on every decision. We are hiring this role precisely so those decisions stop coming to us.



Structure & compensation:



Full-time, long-term contractor. Remote.

Working hours with some overlap to US Eastern time.

Compensation dependant on experience with performance bonus tied to channel outcomes.



How to Apply

To help us identify candidates with genuine Shopify channel-ownership experience, please complete the following as part of your application.



Start your application with the word "STOREFRONT".



Please answer each question in 150 words or less.



Describe one change you personally made to a Shopify store that improved conversion rate or average order value. What did you change, and what happened to conversion (or AOV), sessions, and revenue? Give the before and after numbers.

Describe the largest Shopify store where you owned results, not just executed tasks. What was the catalog size, approximate annual revenue, and what were you personally accountable for?

Record a short Loom video (approximately 2 to 3 minutes). Choose any Shopify store or product detail page (ours at 
, or any public store) and explain:





What you would change first

Whether the opportunity is a traffic problem or a conversion problem, and how you can tell

Why you would make that change

What impact you would expect it to have



Applications that do not include all of the above information will not be considered.

title: Senior Accounting and Bookkeeping Manager
description:
We are a short-term rental management and investment company managing and investing in vacation rental properties across the United States. We provide end-to-end property management services, including reservation management, guest support, cleaning and maintenance coordination, revenue tracking, owner statements, and payment processing.



As our business grows, we are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable remote Senior Accounting & Bookkeeping Manager to manage our day-to-day financial operations, including booking revenue, expenses, vendor payments, owner payouts, reconciliations, tax filings, and financial reporting.



Key Responsibilities

- Review and reconcile booking revenue from Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, and other sales channels.

- Track refunds, adjustments, platform fees, taxes, and payout records.

- Record and categorize operating expenses, vendor bills, cleaning fees, maintenance costs, supplies, and other property-related expenses.

- Prepare and verify payments to cleaners, maintenance workers, vendors, contractors, and property owners.

- Prepare monthly owner statements by property, including income, expenses, management fees, reimbursements, deductions, and owner payouts.

- Reconcile bank transactions, credit card statements, payment processor records, platform payouts, and internal accounting records.

- Prepare regular financial reports, including revenue, expenses, cash flow, profit summaries, and property-level performance reports.

- Prepare and file applicable city and state sales tax returns.

- Assist with year-end financial statements and tax filing preparation.

- Identify accounting issues, improve workflows, and help build financial SOPs, reporting templates, and internal control processes.

- Work with operations, guest support, property management, and maintenance teams to verify expenses, resolve discrepancies, and confirm vendor bills.

- Support pricing reviews and ongoing rate adjustments for short-term rental properties.



Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

- 5+ years of experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance operations, or financial management.

- Proven bookkeeping or accounting experience with U.S.-based companies.

- Strong understanding of revenue tracking, expense management, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting.

- Proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Excel, Google Sheets, and other accounting tools.

- Experience with real estate, rental properties, Airbnb, short-term rental management, hospitality, or property management preferred.

- Experience with Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, AppFolio, Xero, or similar platforms is a plus.

- Familiarity with U.S. sales tax filings, contractor payments, vendor payments, and real estate-related accounting.

- Understanding of U.S. tax concepts related to real estate, rental properties, depreciation, and short-term rentals is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail, high accuracy, and solid analytical skills.

- Highly organized, deadline-oriented, and able to work independently in a remote environment.

- Fast learner who can adapt to new tools, systems, and workflows.

- Able to identify financial issues, provide insights, and suggest practical improvements.

- Comfortable handling urgent or last-minute tasks when needed.



To apply, please complete the questionnaire.

title: Meta Account & Infrastructure Manager (Internal Structures)
description:
Remote · part-time · DTC ecommerce



We're a multi-brand DTC company scaling daily on Meta across several markets. Growth lives and dies on the structure behind the ads — so this role owns the internal side of Meta: the infrastructure that keeps us scaling. Healthy ad accounts, clean pages, working tracking, and a setup that holds up when Meta gets strict.



This is not creatives and not media buying. It's the back-end machine that lets the rest of the team run. If you understand how Business Manager actually works under the hood — and you like keeping a complex system clean — keep reading.



What you'll do:



Ad accounts

Anticipate capacity needs and request new ad accounts before we hit limits.

Warm up new accounts properly so they're stable before they carry real spend.

Run engagement campaigns to keep assets active and healthy.





Pages & setups

Set up new pages end to end — name, profile, details — without tripping disallowed words or policy.

Stand up new setups cleanly: connect pixels to ad accounts, link pixels to WeTracked, and share ad accounts to the right profiles.





Structure & health

Keep the structure fresh and resilient — never more than 2 restricted profiles per group.

Organize how accounts and profiles are shared so nothing becomes a single point of failure.

Stay on top of Meta's policy shifts and adjust the structure before they bite.





Documentation & moderation

Keep our Miro board matching the live structure at all times.

Moderate comments across all ads and ~30 pages daily — plan for real daily time on this.





What you need

Hands-on experience with Meta's internal structures — Business Manager, profiles, ad accounts, pages. Non-negotiable.

A real grip on account warming, restrictions, and keeping a structure ban-resistant.

Experience connecting pixels with WeTracked (or a server-side / CAPI tool you can adapt from).

Organized, reliable and detail-obsessed — this is recurring daily ops, so consistency beats flair.

Able to work independently and own your area with minimal hand-holding.

Solid written English; comfortable in Miro (or quick to learn).





Nice to have

Experience inside a DTC / ecommerce media-buying operation.

Worked across multiple markets or languages.





The honest reality

This is an infrastructure/ops role, not creatives or media buying — repetitive by nature. The wins are quiet: nothing breaks, accounts stay live, tracking just works. If you love keeping a complex machine running and take pride in a clean structure, you'll thrive. If you want to build creatives or scale budgets, this isn't your seat.

title: Credit Consultation Specialist & Client Intake VA

We are looking for an articulate, high-vibe Credit Consultation Specialist to handle inbound/outbound warm leads, conduct deep-dive credit analyses, and seamlessly onboard new clients into our premium program.  

The Mission & Primary Goal:

Your core objective is to take warm leads—including credit turn-downs sent directly over by our strategic B2B referral partners (Mortgage Officers, Realtors, and Dealerships)—and guide them through our luxury onboarding experience. You will walk clients through pulling their reports, analyze their data with paralegal precision, deliver an expert financial assessment, and close the contract.  

Daily Responsibilities:

• Warm Lead Outreach: Contact warm leads immediately as they are generated or referred by our partner network.

• Link Distribution & Closing: Send over customized onboarding links and contracts to ready-to-close clients, ensuring a flawless signup process.

• Pipeline Tracking: Keep client statuses updated daily inside our tracking ecosystem to ensure no lead drops off.

Requirements:

• Flawless English & Consultative Sales Tone: Perfect verbal and written English skills are mandatory. You must speak with the natural confidence of a consultant, not a high-pressure telemarketer.  

• Analytical Eye: Experience reading and interpreting US credit reports (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion) is highly preferred. You must be able to spot reporting discrepancies easily.

• High Emotional Intelligence: Ability to speak with empathy, maintain absolute confidentiality, and hold an upper-echelon standard of service with clients facing financial roadblocks.

• Tech Literacy: Highly proficient with Google Workspace (Sheets, Forms, Calendar) and secure browser navigation. Must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a completely quiet workspace.  

Compensation & Perks:

• Base Pay: $5.00 / Hour.  

• Schedule: Part-Time, 20 Hours per week.  

• Bonuses: Generous performance incentives and cash bonuses for high conversion rates and exceptional closing efficiency.

- identify strong hook 
nts

**IMPORTANT:**

Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries.



### Thumbnails



You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video:



- clean, modern design

- clear focal point

- readable text at small sizes

Most visuals and scripts will be provided.

## Editing Style Requirements



We are looking for editors who understand:



- pacing

- storytelling rhythm

- educational retention

- visual clarity

- modern YouTube editing



This is NOT 
 editing.



We prefer:



- clean cinematic pacing

- calm confidence

- modern documentary feel

- clarity over flashy effects



---



## NON-NEGOTIABLES



### Accuracy Matters



This is financial and mortgage content.



All:



- text

- numbers

- names

- graphics

- statistics



MUST match the spoken audio exactly.



Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit.



### Communication



We value:



- responsiveness

- reliability

- professionalism

- clear communication

- consistency



If deadlines change, communicate early. Silence is the fastest way to lose this role.



### Turnaround Expectations



Typical turnaround:



- 24–48 hours for long-form edit

- Revisions handled quickly



---



## Workflow



Typical workflow:



1. Long-form video delivered first

2. Revisions completed

3. Shorts created from approved final video

4. Thumbnail finalized



We are building:



- templates

- SOPs

- editing systems

- reusable assets



Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow.

## Included Resources

- raw footage

- branding direction

- Ability to follow detailed instructions

- Basic thumbnail design



Bonus:

- educational content editing

- storytelling instincts

## Important Notes



We are looking for:



- long-term relationship

- reliability

This role may scale to:

- additional responsibilities

 or WhatsApp

I'll reply with a youtube video to see if your current skills can match this level of quality.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist (Stripe Billing + QuickBooks) for US Marketing Agency
description:
Own the billing and collections for a US marketing agency. If you're an experienced AR or bookkeeping professional who likes being the person everyone trusts with the money, this is your seat.



ABOUT US



RoofIgnite is a US-focused marketing agency. We run Meta advertising for roofing contractors doing $2.5M or more per year, and we're part of the 
 portfolio. We're a small, tight remote team, and almost all of our team is based in the Philippines, so you'll be in good company.



Our clients pay us a monthly retainer. The work is good and the clients stay. The one gap we have is on our own books: billing goes out late because nobody on the team has the time to run it on a strict schedule. That delay costs us real money every month. We want one reliable person to take full ownership of it so it never slips again.





THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



You make sure every client is billed correctly and on time, you chase down anything that's late or failed, and you keep our books clean in QuickBooks.



This is a high-trust role. You will have direct control over the company's incoming cash, working closely with the two owners. We're looking for someone who treats accuracy and follow-through as a point of pride.





WHAT YOUR WEEK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE



Most of your time, the core of the job:



Billing in Stripe.

When the team tells you a client is ready to be charged, you create and send the charge in Stripe right away. This is manual and on purpose, we don't auto-bill, because we confirm with each client first. It's roughly 60 to 70 charges a month, usually $3,500 to $5,000 each, some larger. You own the billing calendar so nothing is ever late.



Collections.

When a payment fails or a client goes quiet, you run the follow-up. You'll work from a dedicated 
 address and you'll
 and call US clients directly. The escalation path is clear: friendly reminder, firm follow-up, phone call, flag to leadership if a service pause is needed, then final notice. Often a failed payment just needs someone to get the client on the phone and sort out a new card. That someone is you.



Recovering overdue accounts.

Some accounts go past due (we count that as a missed billing cycle, or 14 or more days late with no reply). You take those on and recover them.



Reporting.

You keep the owners updated on what's late, what's at risk, and what you've recovered, so we always know where our cash stands.



A smaller, steady part of the job:



QuickBooks bookkeeping.

You categorize expenses in QuickBooks. The rules and SOPs already exist and most transactions sort themselves automatically. You handle the ones that don't (roughly 500 to 600 a month) and send anything unusual for approval. You're running the system we built, not building it.



Data quality checks.

You audit two of our Google Sheets (a B2B sales tracker and a client check-in sheet) for missing or incomplete information, then track down the correct data and fill the gaps. Example: a lead marked "set and confirmed" while the "setter qualified" field is blank. You catch it and fix it.



Keeping an eye on the numbers.

You watch our key sales and marketing figures and flag anything that looks off.



Occasionally:



Helping onboard new hires in BambooHR, as needed. This is light and infrequent.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



This role only works for a specific kind of person, so please read honestly.



You need two strengths that don't always come together: real precision with numbers, and the confidence to chase money without backing down. Plenty of people have one. The careful ones can be too soft to push a late payer. The pushy ones miss the small errors that make an invoice wrong. We need both in the same person.



You should have:



- 2 or more years in accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or collections (more is welcome).

- Real, hands-on Stripe and QuickBooks experience. Not "I've seen it," but "I've run it."

- Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll represent us to US clients by
 and phone, so both matter.

- A steady, organized approach to deadlines. You're the kind of person who keeps a list and works it.



Nice to have (not required): GoHighLevel, ClickUp, BambooHR, and strong Google Sheets skills.





HOURS AND PAY



Full-time, EST business hours. That's a night shift in the Philippines, roughly 9pm to 6am your time. Where you live doesn't matter as long as you work those hours reliably.



Base pay is $1,500 to $1,700 USD per month depending on experience. On top of that, you earn performance bonuses tied to things like overdue accounts recovered, on-time collection, and clean, accurate data. Do the job well and you earn more.



This is an immediate hire. We want to bring someone on as soon as we find the right fit.





BEFORE YOU APPLY: COMPLETE THE BILLING ACCURACY CHECK



Every applicant must complete this short billing accuracy check. It's a real sample of the work:







Completing it is required, not optional.



To prove you read this whole post, start your application with the word LEDGER.



Any application that skips the test, skips the LEDGER keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a firm requirement.





HOW TO APPLY



Along with starting your message with LEDGER, send a recording. This is required, not optional. Use Loom video or any application/software that shares your face and screen at the same time.



In your recording, cover:



1. Your name and where you're based.

2. Your accounts receivable, billing, and collections experience.

3. The tools you've actually used hands-on.

4. Your answers to the three questions inside the billing accuracy check: which rows have an incorrect Total Charged and the correct amount for each, what went wrong in each case (a fee added that shouldn't be there, a fee missing, or the ad spend math), and what you'd check before sending the invoice.



Only applicants who complete the check and send a recording will be considered for an interview. No recording, no interview.



We also use the recording to hear your spoken English and get a feel for your personality, since this role talks to clients. So speak clearly and naturally, and just be yourself.

title: Case Management Coordinator
description:
We're looking for someone who loves organization, follow-through, and communication.





Specifically, We are looking for someone who can manage a large volume of court-related information, communicate with clients, and make sure important details never fall through the cracks.



If you enjoy solving problems, staying organized, and keeping people informed, this may be the role for you.



---

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You:



* Take ownership of your work

* Follow through without constant reminders

* Communicate clearly and professionally

* Enjoy talking on the phone

* Stay organized while handling dozens of active matters

* Notice discrepancies and investigate them

* Learn technology quickly

* Want to grow professionally



We don't need someone who simply completes tasks.



We need someone who takes responsibility for outcomes.



---

WHAT YOU'LL DO



Every day you will:



* Call courts regarding court dates and case information

* Obtain docket numbers and case status updates

* Verify court settings and upcoming appearances

* Update the pms with accurate notes and case information

* Follow up on motions, judgments, and case closures

* Communicate with clients regarding court dates and case updates

* Send payment reminders and follow-up communications

* Review files for missing information

* Flag issues before they become problems

* Document all activity thoroughly and accurately



This is a high-volume position.



You should expect to make 30–40 calls per day to courts and clients.



---



TOOLS USED DAILY



* CRM

* Callrail

* Slack

* Google Workspace



---



## REQUIREMENTS



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

* Strong attention to detail



Experience working in a law firm is helpful but not required.



---



## APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A short video introducing yourself and why you are a good fit for the position.

3. A real example of a problem you identified and solved without being asked.

title: Personal  Injury Case Manager
description:
We're looking for a Personal Injury Case Manager who can help move cases from intake through settlement.



We are looking for someone who can think through a file, identify what is missing, anticipate problems, and help keep cases moving forward.



Our firm handles personal injury cases throughout Louisiana. We are investing heavily in systems, technology, and case development. We want tea
mbers who take ownership, solve problems, and help us deliver exceptional service to our clients.



---



## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



This matters more than your resume.



You:



* Take initiative without waiting to be told every next step

* Stay organized while managing multiple active cases

* Communicate professionally with clients, providers, and insurance companies

* Notice when a file is missing information

* Follow through consistently

* Think critically about what needs to happen next

* Enjoy solving problems

* Learn technology quickly

* Want to improve and grow professionally



We do not need someone who simply completes assigned tasks.



We need someone who can help move cases forward.



---



## WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will help manage personal injury cases from the time a client signs with the firm until the case resolves.



Your responsibilities may include:



### Client Communication



* Communicate regularly with clients regarding case status

* Answer client questions and concerns

* Request information and documentation from clients

* Keep clients informed throughout the life of the case

* Follow up with clients who become unresponsive



### Medical Records & Treatment Management



* Request medical records and billing records

* Track treatment progress

* Follow up with medical providers

* Monitor gaps in treatment

* Identify missing records or outstanding documentation

* Maintain accurate medical timelines



### Insurance & Case Development



* Communicate with insurance adjusters

* Confirm policy information

* Assist with claim documentation

* Track settlement negotiations

* Assist with demand package preparation



### Case Management



* Maintain organized electronic files

* Update Pipedrive and internal systems

* Monitor deadlines and important milestones

* Identify files that have stalled

* Escalate issues that require attorney attention

* Help ensure that no case falls through the cracks



---



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Six months from now:



* Clients receive timely updates

* Records are obtained quickly

* Cases move efficiently through the pipeline

* Deadlines are not missed

* Files remain organized and current

* Problems are identified before attorneys discover them

* The team trusts you to manage your cases effectively



Most importantly:



You are helping move cases toward resolution instead of waiting for someone else to tell you what to do next.



---



## TECHNOLOGY



We embrace technology, automation, and AI to help us serve clients better.



You do not need AI experience, but you should be comfortable learning new systems and adapting to new workflows.



People who enjoy technology tend to do well here.





## REQUIREMENTS



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

* Strong organizational skills

* Strong attention to detail



Experience in any of the following is a plus:



* Personal Injury Law

* Insurance Claims

* Medical Records Management

* Legal Case Management

* Customer Service



## APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please submit:



1. Your resume.

2. A short video introducing yourself.

3. Tell us which personal injury software, CRMs, or case management systems you have used.
