title: Software Engineer
description:
About the role



We're an AI-native B2B revenue platform. The product is built and growing — a client dashboard, payment and onboarding pipelines, partner portals, and the automation layer underneath. The architecture and product direction are owned. What we need is someone who takes architectural decisions and follows through on them across the full stack — frontend and backend — shipping clean, fast, and without hand-holding.



You won't be setting the overall product direction, but you will be trusted to execute architectural decisions that touch both the frontend and backend of the product, and to carry them through end to end. If you're great at turning a clear direction into shipped, working software across the whole stack, read on.



What you'll do



Execute architectural decisions across frontend and backend, owning the implementation from spec to shipped

Build features against a defined architecture: dashboard UI, internal tools, API endpoints, data syncs

Write and wire backend logic — webhooks, scheduled jobs, third-party API integrations

Work directly against Supabase (Postgres/PostgREST), keep the schema and constraints clean

Build and maintain n8n workflows connecting payment, CRM, and outreach systems

Ship, test, and flag issues before they hit production

Keep ticket status updated in real time — status is the source of truth, not what's in your head

Stack you'll work in



Supabase (Postgres, PostgREST, RLS), n8n, Make, React, Node, Render, Stripe, Clay, Smartlead, Airtable, Apollo, and REST APIs across HeyReach/Wise and similar. You don't need every one, but you need to pick up an unfamiliar API from docs fast and without supervision.



You're a fit if you



Can follow through on architectural decisions that affect both the frontend and backend of a product

Are fluent with AI-assisted development — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar agentic IDEs are part of how you ship

Ship working code from a written spec without needing it re-explained

Are comfortable in Postgres: schema design to a brief, constraints, joins, upserts/on-conflict

Have built real integrations against third-party APIs (webhooks, auth, idempotency, retries)

Read docs and figure things out rather than waiting to be told

Batch your questions, flag blockers early, and keep status current

Have reasonable overlap with UK hours for a daily sync

Preferred experience



Background in the lead gen / GTM / outbound space (Clay, n8n automations, Smartlead, Make, cold
/LinkedIn infrastructure)

Built automation systems or campaign tooling at an agency or GTM startup

Stripe (Checkout, webhooks, Payment Links)

Worked somewhere you owned delivery, not just tickets

How you'll be evaluated



The interview is a paid test task: one real ticket from our backlog, tightly scoped. We're looking at whether you ship it clean, whether you caught the edge cases, whether you kept us updated, and whether you needed babysitting. That's the whole signal.

title: Virtual Assistant: Lead Generation, Content and Social Media
description:
About ComplyEdge



ComplyEdge® is a Sydney-based regulatory compliance and risk advisory firm. We help Australian businesses meet their regulatory obligations and turn compliance into a commercial advantage.



Not Just Compliance. It’s an Edge.



We work across six service lines: Regulatory Compliance Advisory, AML/CTF and Financial Crime Compliance, Employment and IR Compliance, Regulatory Response and Breach Management, a Managed Compliance Partner retainer, and Regulatory Health Reviews. Our clients range from professional services practices to financial services businesses across Australia.



We are a growing firm that works to a high standard. The person we hire will work directly with our Director and Principal Consultant and will play a genuine part in how the business grows.

About the Role



We are looking for a capable, reliable virtual assistant to support three areas of the business: lead generation and pipeline building, content creation and social media management, and day-to-day administration.



This is a long-term role for someone organised, proactive, and comfortable working independently. You will report to the Director and work remotely from the Philippines, with a few hours of daily overlap with Sydney business hours for live coordination.



You do not need a compliance background. You do need strong written English, sound judgement, attention to detail, and the discipline to manage your own workload and meet deadlines.



What You’ll Do



Lead Generation and Pipeline Support



• Research and build targeted lists of prospective business clients from public sources such as LinkedIn, industry directories, and the web.

• Identify decision-makers at firms that fit our ideal client profile and capture accurate contact details.

• Draft and send first-touch outreach and follow-up messages using approved templates and our brand voice.

• Maintain a clean, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM, logging activity, responses, and next steps.

• Track outreach performance and prepare simple weekly summaries of leads generated and meetings booked.

• Schedule discovery calls and keep the Director’s pipeline organised.



Content Creation and Social Media Management

• Manage and grow our social media presence, primarily LinkedIn and Instagram including scheduling and publishing approved posts.

• Set up and optimise social profiles, including headlines, banners, and company page details.

• Draft posts, captions, and short-form content aligned to our brand voice and style guide, for review and approval before publishing.

• Repurpose longer pieces into carousels, graphics, and snippets using tools such as Canva.

• Build and maintain a content calendar and keep a consistent posting schedule.

• Monitor engagement, respond to comments and messages as directed, and report on reach and engagement.

• Carry out light editing of documents, graphics, and short videos to a clean, professional standard.

Administrative Support

• Manage the calendar, schedule appointments, and coordinate meetings across time zones.

• Triage and manage the inbox and respond to routine enquiries as directed.

• Prepare and format documents, presentations, reports, and meeting notes.

• Keep digital files and folders organised and easy to find.

• Carry out internet and general research and compile findings into clear summaries.

• Provide general operational support to keep the business running smoothly.



What We’re Looking For



Essential



• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Two or more years of experience in a virtual assistant, lead generation, marketing, or administrative role.

• Hands-on experience with lead generation and prospecting, ideally including LinkedIn.

• Experience managing social media, especially LinkedIn and Instagram, including scheduling tools.

• Confident with Canva or similar tools for simple graphics and content.

• Comfortable with CRMs, spreadsheets, and common productivity and scheduling tools.

• Strong organisation, attention to detail, and the ability to manage your own time and meet deadlines.

• A reliable, private internet connection and your own computer.

• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy, with genuine respect for confidentiality.



Nice to Have



• Experience supporting Australian, UK, or US businesses.

• Background in professional services, finance, or B2B services.

• Basic video editing and graphic design skills.

• Familiarity with SEO basics and
 marketing tools.

• Experience writing first-draft business or marketing copy.



Why You’ll Like Working With Us



• A long-term, stable role with an established Australian firm.

• Direct access to the founder and real ownership of your work.

• Clear expectations, organised systems, and respectful communication.

• Room to grow your responsibilities as the business grows.



How We Work



• Engagement.  Independent contractor. You are responsible for your own taxes and statutory obligations in the Philippines.

• Hours.  Part Time. Set hours by agreement, with daily overlap with Sydney business hours for coordination.

• Location.  Fully remote from the Philippines.

• Pay.  Paid in accordance with agreed timing (weekly or fortnightly)

• Tools and security.  You will use your own device with up-to-date security software and a private, secure internet connection. Access to our systems is through assigned, personal logins with multi-factor authentication.

• Confidentiality.  ComplyEdge works in a regulated industry. The successful candidate will sign a non-disclosure agreement and follow our confidentiality and data-handling standards. This role focuses on business development, content, and administration. It is not a client compliance role.



How to Apply



We read every application properly, so please follow these steps:

1. Start your message with the word EDGE so we know you have read this advert in full.

2. Tell us briefly why this role suits you and share your most relevant experience.

3. Include links or examples of social media profiles you have managed, or lead generation results you are proud of.

4. Note your available hours and your expected monthly rate.

title: IT & Digital Operations Specialist
description:
# IT & Digital Operations Specialist



**Location:** Remote (Philippines)

**Schedule:** Full-Time (38 hours/week) – U.S. Business Hours Required

**Compensation:** Based on Experience

**Reports To:** Operations & Leadership Team



## About the Role



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and technically capable **IT & Digital Operations Specialist** to become a core member of our team.



This role goes beyond traditional IT support. You will be responsible for helping manage the company's digital infrastructure, employee technology, business systems, information management, onboarding and offboarding, security, documentation, and operational processes.



The ideal candidate enjoys solving problems, supporting people, organizing information, improving systems, and helping businesses operate more efficiently through technology.



As our organization grows, this role will evolve into an increasingly strategic position helping build the operational and technology foundation that supports scalability, automation, AI adoption, and long-term growth.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### IT Support & Employee Technology



* Serve as the primary technology support contact for employees and contractors

* Troubleshoot hardware, software, login, access, connectivity, and device issues

* Support Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, Slack, Dropbox, and other company software

* Assist employees with setup, configuration, and day-to-day use of company systems

* Manage internal IT support requests and ensure timely resolution



### User Account & Access Management



* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts

* Manage Microsoft 365 administration and permissions

* Manage Slack users, channels, permissions, and access levels

* Create and maintain company
 accounts, aliases, and distribution groups

* Conduct regular audits of user permissions and access rights

* Ensure proper access controls and security practices across all systems



### Employee Onboarding & Offboarding



* Prepare computers, accounts, permissions, and software access for new hires

* Coordinate technology onboarding for employees and contractors

* Manage employee offboarding, including:



  * Account deactivation

  * Device recovery

  * Access removal

  * Security reviews

  * Documentation updates



### Knowledge Management & Information Systems



* Organize and maintain company file structures across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Dropbox, and other platforms

* Develop standardized folder structures and information management best practices

* Help create and maintain a centralized company knowledge base

* Ensure documents, resources, and information remain organized, secure, and accessible

* Support the creation of AI-ready documentation and information systems



### Systems Administration & Digital Operations



* Maintain company software, subscriptions, licenses, and technology vendors

* Track technology assets and equipment inventory

* Manage software renewals and licensing compliance

* Identify opportunities for technology consolidation and cost savings

* Recommend improvements to systems, workflows, and operational processes



### Security & Compliance



* Help maintain secure company technology systems

* Monitor user access and security controls

* Support password management and authentication best practices

* Ensure former employees and contractors are properly removed from all systems

* Assist with cybersecurity awareness and security initiatives



### AI, Automation & Systems Integration



* Be curious and excited about AI, automation, and emerging technologies

* Support implementation of AI tools and business applications

* Assist with software integrations, automations, connectors, and workflow improvements

* Help organize company information and systems to support future AI initiatives

* Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency through technology



### Operational & Administrative Support



* Partner with HR and Operations on employee lifecycle processes

* Help coordinate recurring tea
etings and company operational processes

* Assist with documentation, SOP creation, and process management

* Support special projects and take on additional responsibilities as the organization grows



---



## Qualifications



### Required



* 3+ years of IT support, systems administration, or technology operations experience

* Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience

* Experience managing Slack,
 systems, Dropbox, and cloud-based software

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

* Excellent organizational and documentation abilities

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Experience supporting remote teams

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities



### Preferred



* Experience supporting U.S.-based organizations

* Experience with cybersecurity best practices

* Familiarity with business process automation and integrations

* Experience with knowledge management systems and documentation

* Interest in AI, automation, and emerging technologies

* Experience working closely with HR, Operations, or People teams



---



## Work Requirements



* Must be available to work full-time during U.S. business hours

* Must have reliable high-speed internet

* Must have a dedicated professional work environment

* Camera-on participation is required during meetings and team collaboration sessions

* Must maintain professional audio and video quality

* Must proactively communicate any outages, emergencies, or interruptions through company communication channels

* Must be highly responsive, dependable, and accountable



---



## Compensation & Benefits



* Competitive compensation based on experience

* Remote work environment

* Paid company holidays

* Paid vacation/PTO for the right candidate

* Long-term growth opportunities within the organization

* Exposure to modern AI, automation, and technology initiatives

* Opportunity to help build and scale the technology foundation of a growing business



---



## What Success Looks Like



The right candidate will become the trusted owner of our company's digital infrastructure by ensuring:



* Employees receive fast, effective support

* Systems remain secure and organized

* Onboarding and offboarding run smoothly

* Information is documented and easy to find

* Technology costs are optimized

title: Operations Manager - Ecommerce
description:
Hi, I'm Wiets, the founder of TechToast Academy. We're 6 months old and sell an Arduino-compatible electronics kit for kids. It's a $199 hardware kit plus a 25-week build-along curriculum on our own learning portal, with lifetime free tech support from real engineering grads. We're doing around $200K/month, almost all fro
ta ads, and we're on track to 10x in the next 6 months.



Here's what and why I'm hiring: I'm a technical, creative founder. I'm great at setting direction and I love the creative and product  development side, but I'm not great at the people side, making sure that everyone's productive, setting deadlines, holding people to KPI's, and always knowing who is working on what. I don't like checking in on people constantly, and I don't always know how to get the best out of someone or how to motivate them properly. That gap is the single biggest thing slowing us down, and it's the job I'm hiring for.



What the team looks like at the 
nt:



1. 2 virtual assistants who run tech support and customer support over
 (one day shift, one night shift. They're genuinely great, almost no backlog ever). They also do some Arduino circuit drawings for our instruction manuals.

2. 1 product developer working on our next kit (a line-following robot). I suspect he could move faster but I don't have the energy or the know-how to manage him on it. I tried making a timeline for him but I'm honestly a bit lost on how to check in with him and make sure he is as productive and motivated as he can be. I also want to give him the right structure so that he does not get lost and always knows what to do.

3. 1 editor for our meta ads.

4.  A creative strategist coming on board. I'll stay close to this person myself, that's the part I enjoy and currently do myself. I'll still want him under your wing, to make sure he stays motivated and has good structure. This is the biggest lever in our 10x.



Our systems: At the 
nt everyone reports to me through 
. We use Shopify for the store backend. We have no project management tool and I track nothing, I just do video meetings every now and then and discuss what they're busy with now over chat during the week. I feel like this can be improved a lot. 



What I want you to take ownership of:



1. Building the machine. Setting up a proper system (project management tool, SOPs, KPIs) so that anytime I log in I can see who's doing what, what's been done, what's next for each person, and what they achieved last week or last month or whatever. I want to know I'm getting my money's worth from everyone and we're moving in the right direction.

2. Keeping everyone productive and accountable without me chasing anyone. The team comes to you for deadlines, priorities and decisions. I'll tell you what I want; you turn it into something that lands well with the team. (I'm too much of a nice guy to create or enforce a KPI, I need you to be the structure.)

3. Managing the product development timeline so we can launch products better and faster. I give the general direction ("here's the product, here's what it should do"); you figure out how to make it happen with the people we have, or tell me who we need to hire.

4. Helping me hire and scale through the 10x. Soon I'll need a curriculum writer for the new product, someone to handle photography for the circuits, an SEO person to get us organic traffic on Google (right now we're 100% Meta and I want to diversify), and probably someone to run a more junior creative-ops role under you. You'd help find and onboard these people.

5. Taking the creative-shoot logistics off my plate. We have a small content team in South Africa shooting professional family/kids footage for our ads, and setting up each shoot (venue, cast, coordination) has been a huge headache for me. I want someone to manage that end to end.



You're probably a fit if:



1. You've run operations for a team through fast growth, not just kept a small team tidy or a large team compliant.

2. You've built SOPs, KPI tracking and accountability systems from scratch.

3. You can hold people accountable in a way that motivates them rather than annoys them. This is the part I care about most.

4. Ecommerce experience is a big plus.

5. You're comfortable hiring and managing other people as we scale.



How to apply:

I kinda want to hear what you can do for me before hearing what you have done for others. Instead of telling me about your past jobs, tell me about MY business. Based on everything I explained above (and feel free to look at techtoast.academy):



1. What's the first system you'd build in your first 30 days, and what would it actually look like? Be specific.

2. I think my product developer could be faster but I don't know how to manage or measure that. How would you handle it?

3. We're all on 
 with zero tracking. What would you set up so I can log in and instantly see who's doing what, what's done, and what each person achieved last week?



One more thing: just write it out in normal text, no need for obviously-AI generated highly formatted responses.

title: Creative Strategist (Direct Response, DTC Health)
description:
Most creative roles are boring. You make one ad, it runs for three months, and you never find out if it worked.



This is the opposite of that.



We're a direct-to-consumer health brand running cold paid traffic on Meta. We test relentlessly, we read the data daily, and we know within days whether a concept is a winner or a loser.



If you're the kind of person who gets a little obsessed with figuring out why one ad crushes and another flops, keep reading.



We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives in the ad account. Someone who finds what's winning and why, then turns that insight into a steady pipeline of new concepts. You'll have real ownership over the creative that drives this brand's growth, and you'll see the results of your work in real numbers, fast.



This is NOT a media buying role. We handle media buying in-house, so you never have to touch a budget or a bid.



Your job is the part most people are too lazy to do well: get the big idea, study what's converting and what's dying, research the market and the customer until you understand them better than they understand themselves, and produce winning concepts on a consistent basis.



What you'll own:



Analyzing ad performance data (thumbstop, hold rate, CTR, CPA) to spot what's working and what isn't, and why

Researching our market, competitors, and customer to develop fresh angles

Writing video ad scripts that hook and hold attention

Creating image/static ad concepts (with copy attached)

Writing landing page and advertorial copy (a strong plus, tested separately)

Implementing copy directly into pages where possible (a bonus, not required)



Apply here: 



Who you'll work with:



You'll work directly with the founder, who handles strategy and media buying, plus a video editor and a VA team who help execute what you create. You won't be stuck doing everything yourself. You'll be the creative engine, and you'll have people to help you ship.



Our stack: Meta Ads, Funnelish, Klaviyo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT/Claude, and AI image tools.



Fluency with AI creative tools is essential.



We move fast because we let AI do the heavy lifting on production, which frees you to focus on the thinking.



How we work:



"Work hard, play hard."



We move fast, test constantly, and care about results over activity.



There's no busywork here and no one watching the clock.



There's just the work, the data, and the next winning idea.



If you think in hooks, angles, mechanisms, and iteration loops, and you get a little thrill reading a retention graph, you'll fit right in.



This role grows with you. Prove you can produce winners, and there's room to take on more ownership, more responsibility, and more pay over time.



If that sounds like you, the next step is simple.



Fill out the application form below. It's a little different from most applications, which is the point. We want to see how you think.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Highly Engaging "Yap" Style to Start) - Long Term
description:
We are looking for a talented, detail-oriented Short-Form Video Editor to join our content creation team. You will be responsible for taking raw video footage and turning it into highly engaging vertical videos (45 seconds to 1:30 long) for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



Our Content Roadmap:

We are going to start exclusively with a clean, high-retention "yap video" style. The editing for this phase needs to be simple but highly engaging, relying on frequent framing adjustments rather than flashy graphics. However, as our channel grows, this role *will eventually evolve* to include high-quality B-roll style videos with voiceovers and captions, as well as simple, comedic-style content. We want someone who can grow into those styles with us.



This is a video by video basis, but looking for a long term partnership that could turn into a part-time thing! 





Content Workflow & Delivery (Crucial Requirement)



Our production system relies on hook testing. For every video concept I film moving forward:

 I will record 1 Body and 3 Different Hooks all in one raw file.

 You will need to edit 3 final video versions per concept (the body stays the same, only the opening hook changes).

 

Delivery Requirement: For each version, you must deliver two exports:

   1. One version **WITH** burned-in captions/on-screen text.

   2. One version **WITHOUT** captions/text (just the clean, cropped video with audio).



 Total delivery per standard concept = 6 final video files.





Key Responsibilities



Dynamic Framing:Frequently crop in and out every few seconds to match the pacing of the speech, emphasize key phrases, and keep the visual layout dynamic.

 

Cut Dead Space: Edit down talking-head footage to ensure a fast-paced, high-retention flow (remove stutters, pauses, and breaths).

 

Hook Variations: Cleanly splice the different hooks onto the front of the same video body to create distinct assets.

 

Clean File Management: Export and organize both captioned and non-captioned versions clearly in Google Drive.



Requirements

 * Strong proficiency in English (both written and spoken) to seamlessly match hooks to the body.

 * High attention to detail and ability to handle multiple file exports efficiently.

 * A reliable, high-speed internet connection.

 * Experience editing vertical short-form content with a proven portfolio (experience with B-roll editing and comedic timing is a huge plus for the future!).



?? IMPORTANT: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS (READ CAREFULLY) ??



To filter out automated applications and find the absolute best fit, **you must complete a quick "Recreate Assignment" to be considered.**

 1. Watch the Inspiration Videos: Look at how these finished videos are styled, paced, and specifically how they crop in and out to keep the energy high:

   * Video Inspo 1: 

   * Video Inspo 2: 

 2. Download the Raw Test Asset: Go to this Google Drive folder to download the raw footage for our test assignment: 

 3. Your Task: Take our raw asset and edit it to match the exact style, pacing, and crop-in/crop-out technique seen in the inspiration links above. (Note: For this specific test video, there is only 1 hook provided, so you only need to submit two total files: one version WITH captions, and one version WITHOUT captions).



How to Apply:

Reply to this post with:

 1. A brief introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

 2. A link to your completed "Recreate Assignment" videos (upload them to Google Drive or Dropbox).

 3. A link to your general portfolio.



Applications without the completed recreate assignment will be automatically ignored.

title: CFO
description:
Job Title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) - ICON Amsterdam



Type: Full-Time



About ICON Amsterdam:

ICON Amsterdam is a leading men's fashion brand renowned for its fusion of contemporary design and timeless sophistication. As we continue to expand our global presence, we are seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to play a key role in our financial management and growth strategies.



Responsibilities:



Financial Strategy:



Develop and implement financial strategies aligned with the company's overall objectives.

Provide leadership in financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting.



Financial Reporting:



Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.

Present financial performance to executive leadership and stakeholders.



Risk Management:



Identify and assess financial risks, implementing strategies to mitigate potential challenges.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.



Budget Management:



Collaborate with department heads to develop budgets and monitor financial performance against targets.

Implement cost-control measures while maintaining a high standard of quality.



Cash Flow Management:



Optimize cash flow by managing working capital and overseeing treasury functions.

Develop and implement strategies to maximize liquidity and minimize financial risks.

Financial Decision Support:



Provide financial insights and guidance to support strategic decision-making.

Conduct financial analysis and modeling for business initiatives.



Audit and Compliance:



Manage the audit process, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.

Implement and maintain effective internal controls.

Investment Strategies:

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

/Instagram) campaigns

Must have

title: Marketing Operations & Website Support VA
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



I’m looking for a part-time Marketing Operations & Website Support VA to support the implementation side of my business marketing systems and website.



This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working inside Squarespace, ClickUp,
 platforms, and forms, and who can take approved content or existing materials and turn them into polished, functional, well-organized assets and workflows.



This is not a senior brand or marketing strategy role. I’m looking for someone strong in implementation, systems, layout, organization, and follow-through.



About the Business



I run a fundraising consulting business that supports nonprofit organizations with strategy, campaigns, and systems. As the business grows, I’m looking for support with the operational side of marketing and website management so things stay clear, consistent, polished, and functional behind the scenes.



I already have website copy, marketing content, and a general direction for much of this work. I do not currently have a formal brand book or fully documented brand standards, so I’m looking for someone who is comfortable working from my existing website, content, and materials and helping bring greater consistency, polish, and clarity through implementation.



What You’ll Be Doing



 - Make updates to my Squarespace website, including copy updates, formatting, layout cleanup, and blog post formatting

 - Take existing website copy and approved content and turn it into visually polished, well-structured website pages with stronger hierarchy, readability, and flow

 - Improve page structure, visual hierarchy, spacing, and presentation within Squarespace

 - Set up, check, and test
 automations and related workflows

 - Help move or recreate forms from Typeform into ClickUp forms and make sure connected workflows and automations are functioning properly

 - Test forms, automations, and backend workflows to make sure things are functioning properly

 - Review website and marketing workflows and flag anything that appears broken, inconsistent, incomplete, or unclear

 - Organize marketing assets, content, and workflow documentation

 - Draft short-form social copy from approved source materials, including podcast episode summaries, newsletter content, website copy, or campaign messaging, for review and approval

 - Support related implementation tasks such as formatting
s, updating landing pages, or organizing backend marketing systems

 - Assist periodically with basic client automation, form, or workflow implementation tasks, where needed and clearly assigned



What Matters Most



Strong attention to detail, comfort with systems, and good judgment are the most important requirements for this role.



I’m looking for someone who can work from existing content, approved copy, and current systems and turn that into clean, polished work with minimal hand-holding. This role requires someone who notices small issues, thinks through how things function, and communicates clearly when something needs clarification.



Experience with Squarespace is important. Experience with forms, automations, and
 platforms is also important. You do not need a full marketing plan or formal brand standards to work from. You do need to be comfortable looking at what already exists, identifying patterns, and making sound implementation decisions that improve consistency and presentation.



You should also have a strong enough eye for web layout and presentation to make good decisions about spacing, hierarchy, readability, and overall page polish.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You:



 - Are confident working in Squarespace

 - Can make content look cleaner, clearer, and more polished online

 - Are comfortable with forms, automations,
 workflows, and backend systems

 - Can carefully test workflows and catch problems before they become bigger issues

 - Can take approved source material and turn it into finished, polished assets

 - Are highly organized and able to keep details moving across multiple tools and tasks

 - Can work independently once you understand the task and the system

 - Communicate clearly and ask useful questions when needed

 - Are interested in a longer-term working relationship



Qualities Needed to Succeed



Integrity

You communicate honestly, follow through on commitments, and let me know if something is unclear or delayed.



Commitment

I’m looking for someone interested in building a longer-term working relationship, not just completing one quick task.



Attention to Detail

You notice broken links, odd spacing, inconsistent formatting, missing steps, incomplete setups, and small issues that others often miss.



Good Judgment

You can make sensible decisions about formatting, organization, layout, and workflow without needing constant direction.



Systems Thinking

You are comfortable thinking through how things connect, how a workflow should function, and where something may be breaking down.



To Apply



Use cccops03 in your subject line. Please begin the first line of your
 application with the words website workflow support.



Please also include:



 - A short note about your experience with Squarespace, website updates, forms, automations, or marketing operations support

 automation or form workflow before launch

 - A note about your current availability and any other clients or jobs you currently have



This is a part-time role to start, with an estimated workload of approximately 5-10 hours per week, with the opportunity for growth. Hours may vary somewhat depending on active priorities and projects.
